capabilities: Sync Jira issues into Markdown files using JQL profiles
Map Jira system and custom fields to frontmatter keys
Wrap field values as wiki links for Graph View and Dataview
Protect personal notes below a section marker during sync
Log sync history and share field mapping presets
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Jira issue data lives outside the vault, so notes can't reference issues through links, Graph View, or Dataview without manual copying.

relations.evidence: syncs Jira issues directly into your Vault
turn field values into [[wiki links]] for Graph View and Dataview queries

requires.name: Jira credentials (API token or personal access token)

summary: Syncs Jira issues into Markdown files with frontmatter and wiki-links via configurable JQL profiles.
